failureNotes.browser-2026-11-16T01-24-17-103Z.json: Second complete affected-browser invocation: 29 passed / 1 failed. failureNotes.browser-2026-11-16T01-33-56-518Z.json: Third complete affected-browser invocation used an incorrectly added HTTP200 success checkpoint in the acceptance test. Actual unchanged acceptance.ts returns HTTP202 for the T5 committed receipt and asynchronous publication. Thus the deliberate drop-ACK branch did not run, the actual page displayed the successfully committed receipt (retained observation), and the old expected unknown-result wait timed out. This was a test implementation mistake, not a product failure or a reason to change the endpoint. Corrected the exact checkpoint/drop condition to HTTP202 and moved the actual-response assertion before the expected unknown-page wait so non202 outcomes fail with their real response. All original SQL, uniqueness, outbox, reopen and original-key recovery checks remain; production/fixture/timeouts/freshness unchanged. Earlier SQL-count failure cause remains unknown.
